log_level.description: The log level for the wrapper script or service managing xml2 invocations.

xslt_stylesheet.description: Optional path to an XSLT stylesheet to be used in conjunction with xml2 if used in an XSLT pipeline.

input_format.description: The default input format for the xml2 filter (e.g., xml, html, csv).

output_format.description: The default output format for the xml2 filter (e.g., flat, xml, html, csv).
